166:   /** Builds a `switch` over a scrutinee using a `br_table` instruction.
167:    *
168:    *  This function produces code that encodes the following control-flow:
169:    *
170:    *  {{{
171:    *  switch (scrutinee) {
172:    *    case clause0_alt0 | ... | clause0_altN => clause0_body
173:    *    ...
174:    *    case clauseM_alt0 | ... | clauseM_altN => clauseM_body
175:    *    case _ => default
176:    *  }
177:    *  }}}
178:    *
179:    *  All the alternative values must be non-negative and distinct, but they need not be
180:    *  consecutive. The highest one must be strictly smaller than 128, as a safety precaution against
181:    *  generating unexpectedly large tables.
182:    *
183:    *  @param scrutineeSig
184:    *    The signature of the `scrutinee` block, *excluding* the i32 result that will be switched
185:    *    over.
186:    *  @param clauseSig
187:    *    The signature of every `clauseI_body` block and of the `default` block. The clauses' params
188:    *    must consume at least all the results of the scrutinee.
189:    */
190:   def switch(scrutineeSig: FunctionType, clauseSig: FunctionType)(
191:       scrutinee: () => Unit)(
192:       clauses: (List[Int], () => Unit)*)(
193:       default: () => Unit): Unit = {
194:     val clauseLabels = clauses.map(_ => genLabel())
195: 
196:     // Build the dispatch vector, i.e., the array of caseValue -> target clauseLabel
197:     val numCases = clauses.map(_._1.max).max + 1
198:     if (numCases >= 128)
199:       throw new IllegalArgumentException(s"Too many cases for switch: $numCases")
200:     val dispatchVector = new Array[LabelID](numCases)
201:     for {
202:       (clause, clauseLabel) <- clauses.zip(clauseLabels)
203:       caseValue <- clause._1
204:     } {
205:       if (dispatchVector(caseValue) != null)
206:         throw new IllegalArgumentException(s"Duplicate case value for switch: $caseValue")
207:       dispatchVector(caseValue) = clauseLabel
208:     }
209: 
210:     // Compute the BlockType's we will need
211:     require(clauseSig.params.size >= scrutineeSig.results.size,
212:         "The clauses of a switch must consume all the results of the scrutinee " +
213:         s"(scrutinee results: ${scrutineeSig.results}; clause params: ${clauseSig.params})")
214:     val (doneBlockType, clauseBlockType) = {
215:       val clauseParamsComingFromAbove = clauseSig.params.drop(scrutineeSig.results.size)
216:       val doneBlockSig = FunctionType(
217:         clauseParamsComingFromAbove ::: scrutineeSig.params,
218:         clauseSig.results
219:       )
220:       val clauseBlockSig = FunctionType(
221:         clauseParamsComingFromAbove ::: scrutineeSig.params,
222:         clauseSig.params
223:       )
224:       (sigToBlockType(doneBlockSig), sigToBlockType(clauseBlockSig))
225:     }
226: 
227:     block(doneBlockType) { doneLabel =>
228:       block(clauseBlockType) { defaultLabel =>
229:         // Fill up empty entries of the dispatch vector with the default label
230:         for (i <- 0 until numCases if dispatchVector(i) == null)
231:           dispatchVector(i) = defaultLabel
232: 
233:         // Enter all the case labels
234:         for (clauseLabel <- clauseLabels.reverse)
235:           instrs += Block(clauseBlockType, Some(clauseLabel))
236: 
237:         // Load the scrutinee and dispatch
238:         scrutinee()
239:         instrs += BrTable(dispatchVector.toList, defaultLabel)
240: 
241:         // Close all the case labels and emit their respective bodies
242:         for (clause <- clauses) {
243:           instrs += End // close the block whose label is the corresponding label for this clause
244:           clause._2() // emit the body of that clause
245:           instrs += Br(doneLabel) // jump to done
246:         }
247:       }
248: 
249:       default()
250:     }
251:   }

292:   /** Performs local dead code elimination and produces the final list of instructions.
293:    *
294:    *  After a stack-polymorphic instruction, the rest of the block is unreachable. In theory,
295:    *  WebAssembly specifies that the rest of the block should be type-checkeable no matter the
296:    *  contents of the stack. In practice, however, it seems V8 cannot handle `throw_ref` in such a
297:    *  context. It reports a validation error of the form "invalid type for throw_ref: expected
298:    *  exnref, found <bot>".
299:    *
300:    *  We work around this issue by forcing a pass of local dead-code elimination. This is in fact
301:    *  straightforwrd: after every stack-polymorphic instruction, ignore all instructions until the
302:    *  next `Else` or `End`. The only tricky bit is that if we encounter nested
303:    *  `StructuredLabeledInstr`s during that process, must jump over them. That means we need to
304:    *  track the level of nesting at which we are.
305:    */
306:   private def localDeadCodeEliminationOfInstrs(): List[Instr] = {
307:     val resultBuilder = List.newBuilder[Instr]
308: 
309:     val iter = instrs.iterator
310:     while (iter.hasNext) {
311:       // Emit the current instruction
312:       val instr = iter.next()
313:       resultBuilder += instr
314: 
315:       /* If it is a stack-polymorphic instruction, dead-code eliminate until the
316:        * end of the current block.
317:        */
318:       if (instr.isInstanceOf[StackPolymorphicInstr]) {
319:         var nestingLevel = 0
320: 
321:         while (nestingLevel >= 0 && iter.hasNext) {
322:           val deadCodeInstr = iter.next()
323:           deadCodeInstr match {
324:             case End | Else | _: Catch | CatchAll if nestingLevel == 0 =>
325:               /* We have reached the end of the original block of dead code.
326:                * Actually emit this END or ELSE and then drop `nestingLevel`
327:                * below 0 to end the dead code processing loop.
328:                */
329:               resultBuilder += deadCodeInstr
330:               nestingLevel = -1 // acts as a `break` instruction
331: 
332:             case End =>
333:               nestingLevel -= 1
334: 
335:             case _: StructuredLabeledInstr =>
336:               nestingLevel += 1
337: 
338:             case _ =>
339:               ()
340:           }
341:         }
342:       }
343:     }
344: 
345:     resultBuilder.result()
346:   }
347: }
